symptoms: Pinpoint brown spots expanding to circular brown lesions with light brown centers
Dark concentric rings and pronounced yellow halos
Severe leaf drop leading to exposed sun-scalded fruit
risk_factors: Warm, humid tropical and subtropical growing conditions (25-32°C)
prevention: Maintain open canopy pruning to promote rapid leaf drying
Avoid planting adjacent to alternative hosts like soybean or cucumber
recommended_actions: Apply azoxystrobin or copper fungicides upon early detection
Remove dead leaf debris from underneath canopy
